================================================================================
cpath ref-returning invocations preserve assignment targets
================================================================================
class C {
    void Set(int value) {
        Ref() = value;
        Ref() += value;
    }
}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(compilation_unit
  (class_declaration
    (identifier)
    (declaration_list
      (method_declaration
        (predefined_type)
        (identifier)
        (parameter_list
          (parameter
            (predefined_type)
            (identifier)))
        (block
          (expression_statement
            (assignment_expression
              (invocation_expression
                (identifier)
                (argument_list))
              (identifier)))
          (expression_statement
            (assignment_expression
              (invocation_expression
                (identifier)
                (argument_list))
              (identifier))))))))
